page.layout: Top: page number at left and running head centred. Two engraved medallions side by side, with no text block between them. One centred text column of two paragraphs. Below the text a tailpiece ornament.

main_text.l: CALIXTVS Papa huius nominis secundus, in Pontifi-
cem eligitur post Gelasium huius nominis secundum, anno
mundi 5080. à Christo nato 1118. fuit hic natione Burgun-
dus, frater Ducis Burgundiæ, prius Archiepiscopus Viénensis,
divinarum scripturarum peritissimus, nec ab humanioribus li-
teris abhorrens. Sanctum Iacobum Apostolum coluit: in cuius
honorem Compostellanam ecclesiam in Archiepiscopatum
erexit. Videto Trithemium. præfuit Ecclesiæ in summo Ponti-
ficatu annos ferè sex.
PIVS, huius nominis Papa secundus, creatur Pontifex an-
no mundi 5419. à Christo nato 1457. Hic Æneas Syluius an-
tea vocatus, natione Tuscus, patria Senensis, vir undecunque
doctissimus, Philosophus, Orator, & Poëta insignis, multa do-
ctrinæ ac ingenij sui monimenta posteris reliquit. In concilio
Basiliensi Prælato cuidam minister fuit: deinde in Scribā Can-
cellariæ Friderici Imperatoris, huius nominis tertij, assumptus,
& Poëta ab eo, Laurea recepta creatus, primò Episcopus, postea
Cardinalis, tandem Papa omnium suffragio electus est. Obiit
Anconæ, Friderico, huius nominis tertio, imperante. Videto
ut supra. Pontificatum gesit annos sex.

page.notes: Two engraved medallions above the text, portraits in profile. The left one has the legend "CALISTVS PAPA TERTIVS" (left and right of the head, as printed). The right one has "PIVS II PON MAX." Both legends are part of the engraving and are not transcribed as text. Tailpiece ornament below the text, no printed words. The "Viénensis" accent is uncertain in the scan. The "Scribā" macron and "gesit" spelling are as printed. No catchword, signature or marginal notes.
